categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Anche Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the motor vehicle inspection industry, providing comprehensive vehicle inspection systems and automotive aftermarket integrated services. Its business segments include manufacturing and sales of vehicle inspection equipment, intelligent driver examination and training systems, vehicle exhaust remote sensing monitoring solutions, highway overload non-site law enforcement solutions, and industry network supervision systems. The company also extends downstream into vehicle inspection station operations and value-added services such as second-hand car trading and insurance agency services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies including high-precision sensors, AI algorithms, cloud collaboration management, and intelligent hardware for vehicle inspection. It independently designs and manufactures key hardware components like inspection platforms and control systems, while software development covers low-level control, application software, and industry supervision systems. Production is order-based, combining in-house manufacturing with outsourced procurement for standard components. The company emphasizes innovation in new energy vehicle inspection technologies and intelligent digital operation platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional vehicle inspection agencies, automobile manufacturers, research institutions, repair enterprises, and government departments related to transportation, environmental protection, and public security. The company serves commercial vehicles, passenger cars, motorcycles, agricultural vehicles, forklifts, and special vehicles. Its aftermarket services target B-end clients such as inspection stations and C-end vehicle owners, covering vehicle inspection, maintenance, second-hand car transactions, insurance, and related services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide across all 31 provincial-level administrative regions in China except Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. It has established service networks in provinces including Shandong, Hubei, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Henan, and Anhui. The company’s inspection stations and service platforms cover major economic zones such as the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Central China Economic Belt. Overseas operations are minimal.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Anche Technologies operates primarily upstream and midstream in the vehicle inspection supply chain. It manufactures and supplies vehicle inspection equipment and systems to inspection agencies and automotive manufacturers. Additionally, it has expanded downstream by acquiring and operating vehicle inspection stations, integrating equipment manufacturing with inspection service operations to form a closed-loop industry chain from equipment R&D to service delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities focus on technological innovation in vehicle inspection, especially for new energy vehicles, intelligent digital operation of inspection stations, and integrated traffic information supervision. R&D initiatives include developing new energy vehicle safety inspection solutions, intelligent driver training systems, AI-enabled digital management platforms, and advanced environmental monitoring technologies. The company aims to lead industry standards, enhance digital transformation, and expand into data intelligence services leveraging AI and big data.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized vehicle inspection systems, network supervision systems, and driver examination systems. The company also earns income from vehicle inspection operation services, value-added services such as second-hand car transaction facilitation and insurance agency commissions, and sales of high-end intelligent equipment and battery swapping facilities. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales and government or large enterprise bidding.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic provider in the motor vehicle inspection industry, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a key industry standard setter. It holds a strong market position with comprehensive product lines and extensive service networks. Competitors include other domestic vehicle inspection equipment manufacturers and service providers, as well as international brands entering the Chinese market. The company’s integrated upstream and downstream business model and technological innovation provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 448 million, a slight decrease of 3.05% year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 213 million, a significant decline due to policy impacts and goodwill impairment. Total assets stood at RMB 2.53 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.79 billion. The company has experienced a challenging growth trajectory recently due to regulatory changes reducing inspection demand but expects recovery aligned with vehicle population growth and aging.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive, integrated vehicle inspection solutions covering safety, environmental, and performance testing, supported by proprietary technologies and extensive industry experience. Its unique value lies in providing end-to-end solutions from equipment manufacturing to inspection station operations and aftermarket services, enhanced by digital and AI-driven platforms. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, broad patent portfolio, and leadership in industry standards differentiate it as a trusted, innovative partner in China’s vehicle inspection and automotive aftermarket sectors.
